description: A top toolbar above the chat transcript (t3-code BranchToolbar idea): chat title + Open-in-editor + git Commit/Push/Create-PR + user-definable per-project custom actions. Ports T3-18 + T3-13 + T3-14 from docs/t3-port-backlog.md, scoped to GitHub via gh, macOS editor launch, commit-message dialog, and modal action output. Built on the shipped chat-primary Conan (branch loop/conan-chat-v1). Backend routes are token-gated + CORS-reflected like the existing gateway routes; frontend is a ThreadToolbar above ChatPane's transcript, h-9 + semantic tokens. Source PRD: prd-conan-thread-toolbar.md. NOTE for the executing agent: read AGENTS.md + HANDOFF.md first — Conan is chat-primary; run the gateway with `npm start` (not npm run dev); verify BOTH :3747 and :5173 after any gateway restart.

userStories.title: Backend: editor detection + open-in route
userStories.description: As a user, I want Conan to detect my installed editors and open a project folder in one, so the toolbar's Open-in works.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/editor/detect returns the editors available on PATH — probe `code` (VS Code), `cursor`, `zed`, `idea` (JetBrains), `subl` (Sublime) via a login-shell PATH (mirror src/doctor/claude.ts) — plus always include a `finder` entry (Reveal in Finder)

POST /api/editor/open {path, editor?} launches the given editor at `path` (its CLI if present, else `open -a <App>`); `finder`/omitted-with-no-preference reveals the folder via `open <dir>`; existence-checked; args passed as an array (no shell injection)
Both routes token-gated (x-conan-token) + covered by the CORS reflector, like the other gateway routes
Unavailable editor / bad path returns a clear JSON error (never a hang or raw stack)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend only. t3 evidence: t3code/packages/contracts/src/editor.ts, apps/server/src/process/externalLauncher.ts, apps/web/src/components/chat/OpenInPicker.tsx. Suggested skills: none.

userStories.title: Backend: git commit + push routes
userStories.description: As a user, I want to commit and push a project's changes from the toolbar.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/agent/git/commit {cwd, message} runs `git add -A` then `git commit -m <message>` in cwd; returns {ok, output} or {ok:false, error} with git stderr surfaced honestly
POST /api/agent/git/push {cwd} runs `git push` in cwd (sets upstream with -u to origin/<branch> when none exists); returns ok/output or a clear error
Both reject a cwd that isn't inside a git work tree with a clear error; args passed as arrays via execFile (no shell), message is not interpolated into a shell
Token-gated + CORS-reflected. Reuse the existing GET /api/fs/git for status (do not duplicate it)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend. t3 evidence: t3code/apps/server/src/git/GitManager.ts, apps/web/src/components/GitActionsControl.tsx. Suggested skills: none.

userStories.title: Backend: create-PR route via gh
userStories.description: As a user, I want to open a pull request for the pushed branch from the toolbar.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/agent/git/pr {cwd, title, body} runs `gh pr create --title <title> --body <body>` in cwd; returns {ok, url} parsed from gh output, or {ok:false, error, reason}

Degrades honestly: when `gh` is not on PATH, not authenticated (`gh auth status` fails), or the remote is not GitHub, return ok:false with a machine-readable `reason` (gh-missing | gh-unauthed | not-github) so the UI can disable + explain — never hang or fabricate a URL
Token-gated + CORS-reflected; args as arrays (no shell); title/body never shell-interpolated
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend. GitHub-only via gh CLI (multi-provider is out of scope). t3 evidence: t3code/apps/web/src/components/PullRequestThreadDialog.tsx, apps/server/src/sourceControl/GitHubSourceControlProvider.ts. Suggested skills: none.

userStories.title: Backend: per-project custom actions — schema + CRUD + run
userStories.description: As a user, I want to define runnable scripts per project and execute them, so the toolbar can host custom actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a `project_action` table (id TEXT PK, project_id TEXT REFERENCES project(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name TEXT, command TEXT, created_at INTEGER) via the idempotent schema.sql + migrate() path (mirror the chat_thread last_message migration in src/db/index.ts)
GET /api/agent/projects/:id/actions lists a project's actions; POST adds {name, command}; DELETE /api/agent/actions/:actionId removes one
POST /api/agent/actions/:actionId/run executes the action's `command` in its project's cwd (via a shell, since commands are user-authored), capturing stdout+stderr (bounded) + exit code; returns them
All token-gated + CORS-reflected; a run never blocks indefinitely (bounded timeout, killed on overrun with an honest error)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend + schema. t3 evidence: t3code/apps/web/src/components/ProjectScriptsControl.tsx, apps/web/src/projectScripts.ts. Suggested skills: none.

userStories.title: UI: thread toolbar shell (title + branch/cwd)

acceptanceCriteria: A new ThreadToolbar.tsx renders pinned above the transcript in ChatPane.tsx, per-thread; h-9 shrink-0, semantic theme tokens only (matches the app's chrome conventions)

Left: the thread's title (display-only for v1 — 'New chat' placeholder until the first prompt). Also shows the cwd basename + git branch (reuse the per-thread git already used for the composer context row)
Right: a slot for the action controls (Open-in / git / custom actions land here in US-006..008) — an empty but laid-out region for now
Renders correctly in light AND dark; does not shift the transcript/composer layout

userStories.title: UI: git actions in the toolbar (Commit / Push / Create PR)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to commit, push, and open a PR from the toolbar.
acceptanceCriteria: A branch + dirty indicator (from GET /api/fs/git). Commit opens a dialog for a message → POST /api/agent/git/commit; Push → POST /api/agent/git/push; Create PR opens a dialog (title, body) → POST /api/agent/git/pr
Create PR is disabled with an explanatory tooltip when the backend reports gh-missing / gh-unauthed / not-github; a successful PR surfaces its URL (toast with an open-link)
Every git error surfaces honestly (toast with the git/gh message); controls disable while a request is in flight; the branch/dirty indicator refreshes after commit/push
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill: in a real git project, commit + push succeed and update the indicator; PR disabled-state shows when gh is unavailable
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002, US-003, US-005. Reuse the app's existing toast (Toaster). Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: UI: custom actions in the toolbar (add + run)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to define per-project scripts and run them from the toolbar.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar renders the project's custom actions (GET .../actions) as buttons; a '+' opens an add-action dialog (name + command) → POST; each action has a delete affordance → DELETE
Clicking an action POSTs .../run and shows the captured stdout/stderr + exit code in a modal (bounded, scrollable); a running action shows a spinner and disables re-click
Actions are scoped to the active thread's project and persist across reloads (from the DB)
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill: add an action (e.g. `echo hi`), run it, confirm the output modal shows 'hi', reload and confirm the action persists
userStories.notes: Depends on US-004, US-005. t3 evidence: ProjectScriptsControl.tsx. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Design + chrome consistency + states pass
userStories.description: As a user, I want the toolbar to feel like first-class Conan — consistent, quiet, correct in light/dark, with sensible empty/error states.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar is h-9 shrink-0 matching the app's other secondary bars; semantic tokens only (no neutral-*/hex), checked against an existing toolbar
All controls render correctly in light AND dark; the toolbar stays quiet (doesn't dominate the thread)
Sensible states throughout: not-a-git-repo (git actions hidden/disabled), no editors detected (Finder-only), gh unavailable (PR disabled + why), no custom actions (just the + affordance)
Keyboard reachable; dialogs (commit/PR/add-action) are focus-trapped and Esc-dismissable
Typecheck passes
